title: Triadic Novelty: A Typology and Measurement Framework for Recognizing Novel Contributions in Science
reasoning: The paper develops a bibliometric framework for measuring scientific novelty. While it applies this framework to the field of Philanthropic and Nonprofit Studies (which includes religious giving and charitable topics in its dataset), the research itself is focused on network science and scientometrics, not the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, ethics, or morals.
